_doc: Stream E (M2). Quests for zone 'gullwick' (The Gullwick Lakes). Format: data/quests/README.md. Rewards: xp = share of a level's XP at the quest level, gold = multiple of a kill's gold; item.tier rolls at your level. `killRare` {zone, slot} names the zone's rare by slot (data/provinces/rares.json). Story-chain quests carry `story: n` (data/quests/province.json).

ferrywoman_nell.name: Ferrywoman Nell
ferrywoman_nell.greeting: Ferry's a copper. Swimming's free. The serpents are also free.

elder_hollis.name: Elder Hollis
elder_hollis.greeting: The lakes feed us. The lakes also try to eat us. Fair trade.

stilt_guard.name: Stilt-guard Emrys
stilt_guard.greeting: Fort's on stilts. Very defensible. Very wobbly.

angler_tobin.name: Tobin the angler
angler_tobin.greeting: Best fishing's by the old shrine. Worst wisps, too.

quests.name: Serpents at the Ferry
quests.offer: Reed serpents keep climbing aboard. They don't pay. Make them stop riding.
quests.done: Free ferry for you. Once. Don't tell anyone.

quests.name: Croaking at Dawn
quests.offer: The croakers are breeding. Gullwick cannot hear itself think.
quests.done: I can hear myself think! It's mostly about fish.

quests.name: The Wobbly Fort
quests.offer: Flitters nest under the stilt fort. Every night they shake it. Every night I am sick.
quests.done: Steady at last. I can eat supper and keep it.

quests.name: Fishing at the Shrine
quests.offer: Clear the wisps off the old shrine so I can fish in peace. Leave a coin in the bowl while you're there, for luck.
quests.done: Peace and pike. What more could a man want?

quests.name: The Underground River
quests.offer: The lakes drain into caves under the hills. Something big lives where the water goes. Follow the river.

steps.text: Defeat what lives at the source

quests.done: The water runs clean again. Mostly.

quests.name: The Lake's Old Grudge
quests.offer: There's one in the deep water that's been holding a grudge since my grandmother's day. End it.
quests.done: Grandmother's grudge, settled. She'd be glad.
